text: Hello friends, Leo the Lion here. Today is just perfect for doing absolutely nothing. The sun feels like a warm fuzzy blanket draped right over my golden mane. I spent the morning watching a single beetle crawl across a leaf. It took an hour. That is the kind of speed I like. No rushing, no hunting, just pure quiet observation.
